notes.text: Wangarĩ Wangari Maathai was a Kenyan social, environmental, and political activist who founded the Green Belt Movement, an environmental non-governmental organization focused on planting trees, environmental conservation, and women's rights.
Wangari Maathai is remembered as a explorer connected with Kenya.
Wangari Maathai's recorded life dates place this profile around 1940-2011.
Wangari Maathai is grouped with Environment, Exploration & Human Achievement in the People Library.
Wangari Maathai's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Kenya historical setting.
